name: Notched Rib
summary: At Agamand Mills, Notched Ribs prove the Forsaken are breaking the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal.

sections.title: Grim Proof of Battle
sections.body: Across northern Tirisfal Glades, the Scourge gathers skeletons in ruined armor. Cracked Skull Soldiers and Rattlecage Soldiers attack any living being or creature with free will they meet. Blades leave their brittle bones pitted and scored. Deathguards demand proof that Forsaken scouts and volunteers are killing these mindless intruders. A battle-marked rib shows that another of the Lich King's thralls has been shattered.

sections.title: Securing the Mills
sections.body: Northwest of Brill, the Agamand Mills hold a key position. If the Scourge settles among the ruined farmsteads and windmills, the undead gain a base from which to strike deep into Tirisfal. Deathguard Dillinger watches the northern roads and sends champions to break up the skeleton ranks before they can gather strength. The notched ribs brought back to Brill show that the Forsaken line holds as it wears down the Scourge vanguard bone by bone.

faq.answer: A Notched Rib is a scarred bone taken from an animated Scourge soldier in northern Tirisfal Glades. It gives Deathguard Dillinger proof that an enemy has been destroyed.

faq.q: Where do Notched Ribs come from?
faq.answer: Notched Ribs come from Cracked Skull Soldiers and Rattlecage Soldiers patrolling the Agamand Mills, northwest of Brill.
Deathguard Dillinger collects Notched Ribs and Blackened Skulls along the road outside Brill to confirm the Scourge advance has been repelled.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge gathering at Agamand Mills?
aliases: why are skeletons at the mills
faq.answer: The mindless undead are trying to establish a base at Agamand Mills, from which they could strike across Tirisfal Glades and threaten Forsaken settlements.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you gather these shattered bones in a war for survival against the Lich King's mindless minions, who would drag you back into servitude.
